The process for VPN access is documented in the IT knowledge base article titled "VPN Access" (KB article ID: IT-KB-108), last updated on 2026-06-20. The article outlines the following steps:

## First-line Troubleshooting
- Confirm whether the target actually requires VPN
- Verify MFA and device trust status
- Check VPN group membership

## Required Ticket Fields
When submitting a request, you must include:
- employee_id
- email
- system (VPN)
- business impact
- error text
- screenshot if safe
- requested access level if applicable

## Escalation
Escalate to IT Manager for:
- Admin access needs
- Over-limit subscriptions
- Security risk concerns
- Missing approvals

The article notes that outdated guidance about shared VPN passwords is no longer valid. All VPN access requests should follow this documented process.
